item.title: Daviess County Arrest
item.description: A Kansas City man was arrested by State Troopers in Daviess County on Tuesday morning. 19-year-old Denilson Hernandez-Garcia was arrested for alleged no valid license and on a Johnson County warrant for alleged speeding. He was taken to the Daviess Dekalb Regional Jail pending the posting of bond.

item.title: MDC To Require Non-Resident Migratory Bird Permit
item.description: Hunters who live outside of Missouri will need a Non-Resident Migratory Bird Permit beginning January 1st. The Missouri Conservation Commission approved the new permit for non-residents to hunt waterfowl, doves, snipe, woodcock, and rails. The new Non-Resident Migratory Bird Permit will cost $60.
